crossrefs.text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.

Now when Daniel learned that the document had been signed, he went into his house, where the windows of his upper room opened toward Jerusalem, and three times a day he got down on his knees, prayed, and gave thanks to his God, just as he had done before.
and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.
Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.
Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,

notes.title: Today, if you hear his voice, enter the rest

crossrefs.text: He named the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us or not?”

Now we who have believed enter that rest. As for the others, it is just as God has said: “So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’” And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world.
do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion, in the day of testing in the wilderness,
where your fathers tested and tried Me, and for forty years saw My works.
not one will ever see the land that I swore to give their fathers. None of those who have treated Me with contempt will see it.
These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the LORD, and He showed His holiness among them.
So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’”
And again, as He says in the passage above: “They shall never enter My rest.”
